trial_court: Family Court No.2, Jodhpur in Civil Original Case No.771/2018 (234/2019) and Civil Original Case No.228/2019 (545/2018)
facts_of_case: Petitioner preferred writ petitions against the order dated 05.10.2021 passed by learned Judge, Family Court No.2, Jodhpur in Civil Original Case No.771/2018 (234/2019) and Civil Original Case No.228/2019 (545/2018).

legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the party seeking to set aside an order under Order 7 Rule 11 CPC to establish that there has been a material change in circumstances.
legal_principles.held: It is not the duty of the court to re-examine the evidence and re-assess the probabilities afresh. The burden lies on the party seeking to set aside an order under Order 7 Rule 11 CPC to establish that there has been a material change in circumstances.

legal_principles.principle: The court will not re-examine the evidence and re-assess the probabilities afresh in an application under Order 7 Rule 11 CPC.
legal_principles.held: It is not the duty of the court to re-examine the evidence and re-assess the probabilities afresh. The impugned order has been passed after considering the entire material on record and it is not open to this Court to re-examine the same.

outcome.final_order: The impugned order, treating the petitioner to be Scheduled Caste, while giving him liberty to move an application under Section 13 of the Hindu Marriage Act is sustained.
